While the hypothesized mechanisms for the relationship between institutional distance and multinational outcomes emphasize the added costs of operating in countries that are institutionally different from a multinational’s home country, the extent to which institutional distance affects financing costs remains unclear. These ex-ante costs of various dimensions of institutional distance are theoretically distinct from post investment liability concerns and imposed on a firm by its creditors and shareholders (rather than local actors). As such, remedies against costs of financial distance as well as their contingencies likely differ from liability of foreignness, requiring separate theorizing and empirical analysis. To understand these effects, we examine 5,649 project finance loans from 2000 to 2013. Consistent with existing theory, we find that banks vary the interest rates they charge on large-scale project finance loans to account for cultural, political, economic, and financial distance. Although BITs between countries did not reduce the costs of financing, prior violations of BITs by host nations cause a significant increase in financing costs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究制度距离对跨国项目融资成本的影响，发现银行会根据文化、政治、经济和金融距离调整贷款利率，双边投资协定本身不降低融资成本，但东道国违反BIT会显著增加融资成本。
AI.research_question: 制度距离如何影响跨国项目融资成本？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注制度距离对投资决策和运营绩效的影响，但制度距离如何影响融资成本尚不清楚。融资成本与运营成本在理论机制和应对措施上存在差异，需要单独的理论构建和实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度距离理论（文化、政治、经济、金融距离）、双边投资协定（BITs）理论、融资成本理论
AI.method: 实证分析2000-2013年间5,649个项目融资贷款数据
AI.findings: 1. 银行会根据文化、政治、经济和金融距离调整项目融资贷款利率；2. 双边投资协定本身不降低融资成本；3. 东道国违反BITs会显著增加融资成本
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将制度距离理论扩展到融资成本领域；2. 区分了融资成本与运营成本的不同理论机制；3. 揭示了BITs对融资成本的实际影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为跨国企业评估融资成本提供参考；2. 帮助银行更准确评估跨国项目风险；3. 为政策制定者理解BITs的实际效果提供依据

title: State of Charge Aware Battery Swapping in Shared E-Bike Systems
affiliations: York University, York University and York University

detail.title: State of Charge Aware Battery Swapping in Shared E-Bike Systems
detail.abstract: Shared electric bicycles have become central to urban mobility, yet maintaining battery availability across dispersed fleets remains challenging. Battery swapping offers a flexible alternative to fixed charging infrastructure in dockless systems, but requires coordinated decisions on routing, vehicle capacity, and service selection. This study proposes an optimization framework that integrates dynamic clustering with profit-aware vehicle routing for battery swapping operations. E-bikes are grouped into serviceable clusters based on state of charge (SOC), spatial proximity, and van capacity, and routing decisions jointly determine which batteries to swap and the sequence. A feedback mechanism iteratively refines cluster assignments and SOC thresholds to balance spatial cohesion and operational efficiency. The framework is evaluated through computational experiments and a real-world case study using Bay Wheels data from San Francisco. Results indicate that dual-threshold SOC policies reduce unnecessary swaps while sacrificing less than 6% of potential profit, supporting scalable and economically efficient battery management.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个优化框架，将动态聚类与利润感知车辆路径规划相结合，用于共享电动自行车电池更换操作。通过基于电量状态、空间邻近性和货车容量的聚类，以及反馈机制迭代优化，实现了在减少不必要更换的同时保持高利润的电池管理。
AI.research_question: 如何在无桩共享电动自行车系统中，通过优化电池更换操作的路由、车辆容量和服务选择决策，实现经济高效的电池管理？
AI.motivation: 共享电动自行车已成为城市交通的核心，但在分散的车队中维持电池可用性仍然具有挑战性。电池更换为无桩系统提供了比固定充电基础设施更灵活的替代方案，但需要在路由、车辆容量和服务选择方面进行协调决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态聚类理论、车辆路径优化理论、电池管理优化理论、运营管理中的决策协调理论
AI.method: 提出一个集成动态聚类与利润感知车辆路径规划的优化框架。基于电量状态、空间邻近性和货车容量将电动自行车分组为可服务集群，路由决策共同确定要更换的电池和更换顺序。采用反馈机制迭代优化集群分配和电量阈值，平衡空间凝聚力和运营效率。通过计算实验和旧金山Bay Wheels数据的真实案例研究进行评估。
AI.findings: 双阈值电量状态策略在牺牲不到6%潜在利润的情况下减少了不必要的电池更换，支持可扩展且经济高效的电池管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了动态聚类与车辆路径规划集成的理论框架；2. 发展了电池更换操作中的多目标优化理论；3. 建立了基于反馈机制的迭代优化理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为共享电动自行车运营商提供了可实施的电池更换优化方案；2. 通过双阈值策略减少了运营成本；3. 支持大规模车队的经济高效电池管理；4. 为城市交通系统提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Fit for Purpose Power Outage Datasets: On using EAGLE-I and IEEE for Reliability Studies
affiliations: Government of the United States of America - Pacific Northwest National Laboratory, Government of the United States of America - Pacific Northwest National Laboratory, Oregon Public Utility Commission, University of Birmingham, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Government of the United States of America - Pacific Northwest National Laboratory

detail.title: Fit for Purpose Power Outage Datasets: On using EAGLE-I and IEEE for Reliability Studies
detail.abstract: Power outage datasets report on the spatial and temporal characteristics of customers without electricity and provide insights into trends in reliability and compliance. As the availability and quality of such datasets vary, an understanding of fit-for-purpose is needed. We compare two U.S. outage datasets, EAGLE-I and IEEE, from 2018-2022 to evaluate their strengths and weaknesses for different scientific questions and identify complementarities. The datasets differ in collection methodologies and in temporal and spatial scales. EAGLE-I captures a snapshot of outages sourced from the web, whereas IEEE compiles data from utilities directly. We use outage statistics, correlations of daily Customers Interrupted (CI), and case studies of extreme events to illustrate their differences. Despite processing the datasets to a common spatial and temporal resolution, direct comparisons are challenging due to differences in their methodologies and data collection approaches. EAGLE-I covers a larger share of customers, contributing to systematically higher CI and the associated estimated Customer Minutes Interrupted (CMI). Pooled across NERC (NERC LTRA) regions, we find weak linear mapping in CI between the two datasets, indicating that, in general, their trends in reliability metrics would not be consistent. Consistency is higher for some NERC regions, specifically Florida, Northwest, Southwest Power Pool, and Texas. EAGLE-I is advantageous for fine-scale, event-focused analysis. IEEE is more suitable for long-term regional benchmarking and analyses that support mapping between power outages and evolving asset characteristics. We conclude that efforts to promote coordination and harmonization between outage datasets are needed to expand analytical capabilities about reliability events.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了美国两种停电数据集EAGLE-I和IEEE（2018-2022年），评估它们对不同科学问题的适用性。EAGLE-I通过网络抓取提供精细的事件分析，IEEE直接从电力公司收集数据适合长期区域基准分析。两者在覆盖范围、数据收集方法和可靠性指标上存在差异，需要协调和标准化以提高分析能力。
AI.research_question: EAGLE-I和IEEE这两种美国停电数据集在科学分析中的优势和局限性是什么？它们如何互补？
AI.motivation: 停电数据集对理解电力可靠性趋势至关重要，但不同数据集在可用性和质量上存在差异。需要了解这些数据集对不同科学问题的适用性，以支持有效的电力系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电力可靠性评估理论、数据质量评估框架、空间和时间尺度分析理论、极端事件分析方法
AI.method: 比较分析两种数据集（2018-2022年），使用停电统计数据、每日受影响客户（CI）相关性分析、极端事件案例研究，并将数据统一到共同的空间和时间分辨率
AI.findings: 1. EAGLE-I覆盖更多客户，CI和CMI值系统性地更高；2. 整体上两个数据集的CI线性映射较弱，可靠性趋势不一致；3. 某些NERC区域（佛罗里达、西北、西南电力池、德克萨斯）一致性较高；4. EAGLE-I适合精细尺度事件分析，IEEE适合长期区域基准分析
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了停电数据集比较评估的理论框架；2. 揭示了不同数据收集方法对可靠性指标的影响；3. 提出了数据集互补性的理论分析
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为研究人员选择合适数据集提供指导；2. 识别了数据集协调和标准化的需求；3. 支持电力可靠性分析和政策制定；4. 为极端事件分析提供方法论参考

title: Design-Time Cyber-Physical System Security Assessment Using a DSL-Driven Simulation Architecture
affiliations: Abdelmalek Essaadi University

detail.title: Design-Time Cyber-Physical System Security Assessment Using a DSL-Driven Simulation Architecture
detail.abstract: The increasing convergence of Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) in Cyber–Physical Systems (CPS) has intensified the need for design-time security assessment mechanisms capable of capturing both cyber and physical consequences of attacks. Existing CPS simulators often lack explicit security semantics, while security modeling approaches rarely support executable cross-domain reasoning. This paper proposes a DSL-driven simulation architecture for design-time CPS security assessment, combining a domain-specific language, CPSEC LANG, with a layered cyber–physical simulator, CPSECSIM. CPSEC LANG provides structured abstractions for critical infrastructures, asset taxonomies, attack models, and defense mechanisms, while CPSECSIM operationalizes these constructs through coordinated model integration, cyber simulation, physical process modeling, security analysis, and visualization layers. The framework establishes a traceable transformation from architectural specification to simulation-based security indicators, enabling systematic exploration of attack propagation and mitigation strategies at the design stage. A worked example based on electrical grid remote management demonstrates how command injection attacks can be modeled and interpreted within the proposed architecture, allowing comparative reasoning across defensive configurations. Although the framework is specified at the architectural level without full implementation benchmarking, it establishes a coherent artefactcentered foundation for secure-by-design CPS engineering and lifecycleintegrated security assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于领域特定语言(DSL)的仿真架构，用于设计阶段CPS安全评估，结合CPSEC LANG语言和CPSECSIM仿真器，支持跨领域攻击传播分析和防御策略比较。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够捕获网络攻击在CPS中跨领域（网络和物理）后果的设计时安全评估机制？
AI.motivation: 运营技术(OT)和信息技术(IT)在CPS中的日益融合，需要能够同时考虑网络和物理后果的安全评估方法。现有CPS仿真器缺乏明确的安全语义，而安全建模方法很少支持可执行的跨领域推理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于领域特定语言(DSL)的仿真架构，结合结构化抽象（关键基础设施、资产分类、攻击模型、防御机制）和分层仿真方法。
AI.method: 提出CPSEC LANG（领域特定语言）和CPSECSIM（分层网络物理仿真器）相结合的架构，通过协调的模型集成、网络仿真、物理过程建模、安全分析和可视化层来实现可执行的安全评估。
AI.findings: 该框架建立了从架构规范到基于仿真的安全指标的可追溯转换，能够在设计阶段系统性地探索攻击传播和缓解策略。通过电网远程管理的实例演示了命令注入攻击的建模和解释，支持跨防御配置的比较推理。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了一个结合DSL和分层仿真的CPS安全评估架构；2) 建立了从规范到仿真的可追溯转换机制；3) 为安全设计CPS工程和生命周期集成安全评估提供了基于工件的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 开发了CPSEC LANG语言用于结构化安全建模；2) 实现了CPSECSIM仿真器支持跨领域安全分析；3) 提供了设计阶段攻击传播分析和防御策略比较的实际工具；4) 通过电网案例展示了实际应用价值。

title: AdapCard: Adaptive Cardinality Estimation via Meta-Learning and Tri-Correlation Sum-Product Networks
affiliations: Northeastern University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Northeastern University (USA), Northeastern University, Northeastern University, Northeastern University (USA) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: AdapCard: Adaptive Cardinality Estimation via Meta-Learning and Tri-Correlation Sum-Product Networks
detail.abstract: Cardinality estimation is a cornerstone of query optimization. However, learned estimators still face a practical bottleneck. Many SPN-based methods rely on a fixed global correlation threshold to partition attributes at product nodes, even though dependence patterns vary widely across datasets and across recursive subproblems. This paper proposes AdapCard, a learned cardinality estimation framework that improves both robustness and efficiency by making thresholding and factorization adaptive. AdapCard introduces (i) TC-SPN, a tri-correlation SPN construction scheme that explicitly isolates moderately dependent attributes to enable earlier factorization without sacrificing fidelity; and (ii) MetaATPM, a meta-learned threshold predictor that maps local dependence structure to node-specific splitting thresholds and transfers across datasets with only a small amount of supervision. We further extend these techniques to multi-table estimation via a decoupled local-model design that reduces training overhead while preserving accuracy. Experiments on standard single-table and multi-table benchmarks demonstrate that AdapCard achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with substantially reduced training and inference cost compared with prior SPN-based estimators.

AI.tldr: AdapCard是一个自适应的基数估计框架，通过三相关SPN构建方案和元学习阈值预测器，在保持准确性的同时显著降低了训练和推理成本。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个自适应的学习型基数估计框架，使其能够根据数据集和子问题的具体依赖模式动态调整相关阈值和因子分解策略？
AI.motivation: 现有基于SPN的学习型基数估计方法通常使用固定的全局相关阈值来划分属性，但不同数据集和递归子问题中的依赖模式差异很大，这限制了方法的鲁棒性和效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于和积网络(SPN)的基数估计理论，结合自适应阈值调整和因子分解策略，引入元学习理论进行跨数据集知识迁移。
AI.method: 提出TC-SPN（三相关SPN构建方案）显式隔离中等依赖属性以支持早期因子分解；开发MetaATPM（元学习阈值预测器）将局部依赖结构映射到节点特定的分裂阈值；采用解耦的局部模型设计扩展到多表估计。
AI.findings: 在标准单表和多表基准测试中，AdapCard实现了最先进的准确性，同时与现有基于SPN的估计器相比，显著降低了训练和推理成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了自适应阈值调整的理论框架；2) 发展了基于元学习的跨数据集阈值预测方法；3) 建立了三相关SPN构建的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 开发了AdapCard框架，提高了基数估计的鲁棒性和效率；2) 实现了可扩展的多表估计方案；3) 提供了实际可用的工具，显著降低了数据库查询优化的计算开销。

title: Deep Learning-Based Detection of Cyber and Malware Attacks in LoRaWAN IoT Systems at the Middleware & Application Layers
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Deep Learning-Based Detection of Cyber and Malware Attacks in LoRaWAN IoT Systems at the Middleware & Application Layers
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of the Internet of Things (IoT) has introduced unprecedented opportunities for smart applications in domains such as healthcare, industrial automation, and environmental monitoring. However, the increasing reliance on resource-constrained IoT devices also exposes these systems to a wide range of cyber and malware attacks. In particular, the LoRaWAN protocol widely adopted for long-range, low-power communication remains vulnerable at the middleware and application layers, where sophisticated attacks can evade conventional intrusion detection methods. In this paper, we propose a novel deep learning-based intrusion detection framework combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) networks for accurate and real-time detection of cyber and malware attacks in LoRaWAN middleware and application Layers. The CNN component efficiently extracts spatial patterns from payload-level and packet-level features, while the BiLSTM captures bidirectional temporal dependencies to model attack behaviors over time.We evaluate our approach on a realistic LoRaWAN traffic dataset augmented with simulated attack scenarios, including flooding, replay, and malicious payload injection. Experimental results demonstrate that our CNN-BiLSTM model achieves superior detection performance compared to conventional machine learning baselines, reaching over 98\% accuracy and significantly reducing false positive rates. This research highlights the potential of hybrid deep learning architectures to enhance the resilience of IoT networks against evolving security threats.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合CNN和BiLSTM的深度学习入侵检测框架，用于实时检测LoRaWAN中间件和应用层的网络攻击，在真实数据集上达到超过98%的准确率。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个准确且实时的深度学习入侵检测框架来保护资源受限的IoT设备（特别是采用LoRaWAN协议的设备）免受中间件和应用层的网络攻击？
AI.motivation: IoT的快速扩张带来了安全挑战，特别是资源受限的IoT设备容易受到网络攻击。LoRaWAN协议在中间件和应用层存在漏洞，传统入侵检测方法难以应对复杂攻击。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习理论，特别是卷积神经网络（CNN）用于提取空间模式，双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM）用于捕捉双向时间依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出CNN-BiLSTM混合深度学习架构：CNN组件从载荷级和包级特征中提取空间模式，BiLSTM组件捕捉攻击行为的时间依赖性。使用增强的真实LoRaWAN流量数据集进行评估，包含洪水攻击、重放攻击和恶意载荷注入等模拟攻击场景。
AI.findings: CNN-BiLSTM模型相比传统机器学习基线表现出优越的检测性能，达到超过98%的准确率，并显著降低了误报率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合CNN和BiLSTM的混合深度学习架构，为IoT安全领域提供了新的理论框架，展示了深度学习在捕捉网络攻击时空特征方面的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可用于实时检测LoRaWAN中间件和应用层攻击的实用框架，提高了IoT网络的抗攻击能力，为医疗、工业自动化、环境监测等领域的IoT应用提供了安全保障。

title: An AI-Enabled Decision Support System for Evidence-based Last Mile Delivery Authentication: Design and Pilot Implementation
affiliations: Indian Institute of Science (IISc) - Department of Management Studies and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: An AI-Enabled Decision Support System for Evidence-based Last Mile Delivery Authentication: Design and Pilot Implementation
detail.abstract: Reliable last mile delivery (LMD) of essential commodities continues to present significant operational challenges, particularly due to delivery disputes, black-market diversion, and the lack of reliable real-time verification at the point of service. To address this gap, this study develops and pilot-implements an AI–enabled Decision Support System (DSS) for secure delivery authentication in LPG cylinder distribution. The proposed DSS integrates a convolutional neural network–based image verification module and a geolocation verification module within a Django-based framework and is deployed as a Progressive Web Application (PWA). In operational use, the system supports distributors by automatically verifying whether cylinders are delivered to the intended customers at their registered delivery locations, thereby enabling evidence-based delivery assurance.,The system was pilot deployed at an LPG distribution agency in Chennai, India, using two delivery agents over a ten-day operational window. During live field operations, the DSS achieved an average end-to-end authentication time of approximately two seconds, with no authentication failures observed during the pilot. These findings demonstrate the operational feasibility of the proposed approach and its ability to provide low-latency, automated delivery verification without imposing additional burden on delivery personnel or customers.,This study contributes to the DSS and logistics literature by introducing a mobile-integrated authentication framework that embeds artificial intelligence within real-time last-mile operations to strengthen delivery accountability and digital trust. Managerial implications related to field deployment, scalability, and operational monitoring are discussed. While the pilot results are encouraging, broader multi-region validation remains an important direction for future research.

AI.tldr: 开发了一个AI驱动的决策支持系统，用于LPG气瓶配送的安全认证，结合图像和地理位置验证，在试点中实现了2秒的平均认证时间且无失败。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个AI驱动的决策支持系统来解决最后一公里配送中的认证问题，特别是LPG气瓶配送中的交付争议、黑市转移和实时验证缺失？
AI.motivation: 最后一公里配送面临交付争议、黑市转移和缺乏可靠实时验证的挑战，特别是在LPG气瓶配送中，需要技术解决方案来确保配送安全和问责。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策支持系统理论、人工智能在物流中的应用、数字信任框架、实时运营监控理论。
AI.method: 开发并试点实施一个集成卷积神经网络图像验证模块和地理位置验证模块的Django框架PWA系统，在印度钦奈的LPG配送机构进行10天实地测试。
AI.findings: 系统在实地操作中平均端到端认证时间约2秒，试点期间无认证失败，证明该方法具有操作可行性，能提供低延迟自动化验证而不增加配送人员或客户负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 为DSS和物流文献引入移动集成认证框架，将人工智能嵌入实时最后一公里运营，加强配送问责和数字信任。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可操作的配送认证解决方案，支持基于证据的配送保证，讨论了现场部署、可扩展性和运营监控的管理意义，为物流公司提供实用工具。

title: Transformers in Privacy-Aware Video Analytics: A Systematic Survey of Lightweight and Self-Supervised Approaches for Smart City Systems
affiliations: Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia and Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia

detail.title: Transformers in Privacy-Aware Video Analytics: A Systematic Survey of Lightweight and Self-Supervised Approaches for Smart City Systems
detail.abstract: The increasing requirement for intelligent video analysis in smart cities calls for privacy-preserving, computationally efficient, and multifaceted learning frameworks that can be adopted in this case. This paper provides a modern self-supervised learning (SSL) methods survey for lightweight video understanding under privacy constraints using transformer architectures. We undertake an exploration of temporal modeling approaches, where we mask reconstruction and contrast learning, keeping the focus on their contributions to dataset-efficient representation learning. Simultaneously, we also look into lightweight transformer models with the aim of overcoming resource limitations, which ride on token reduction, quantization, and the use of dynamic inference mechanisms. Making privacy a top priority, we discuss concealing methods, such as visual obfuscation, adversarial masking at the feature level, and incorporation of transformer-based privacy modules. We discuss how such approaches are capable of dealing with the compromises between the effectiveness of the task, identity protection, and real-time processing. Also, we focus on deployment platforms and practices, considering smart city contexts, and we determine open challenges such as generalization, benchmarks, and privacy–accuracy–cost unification. This paper does so by providing a comprehensive synthesis of over 85 recent studies, defining a taxonomy in relation to SSL, lightweight ViTs, and visual privacy, and creating an outlook for federated learning, adaptive inference, and human-centered systems design. We direct our study to revealing a pathway that leads to creating scalable, reliable video-based analytics systems embedded in edge-enabled smart settings.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了面向智能城市视频分析的隐私保护、轻量级自监督学习方法，重点探讨了基于Transformer的架构在时间建模、轻量化设计和隐私保护方面的最新进展。

AI.practical_contributions: 为智能城市环境中的视频分析系统部署提供了实用指导，指出了可扩展、可靠的边缘智能视频分析系统的发展路径，有助于解决泛化性、基准测试和隐私-精度-成本统一等实际问题。

title: SRCE: A Workload-Shift-Robust Cardinality Estimation Framework
affiliations: Beijing Jiaotong University, Beijing Jiaotong University, Beijing Jiaotong University and Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications

detail.title: SRCE: A Workload-Shift-Robust Cardinality Estimation Framework
detail.abstract: Cardinality estimation is crucial for query optimization, as it directly affects plan selection and query cost. Traditional methods based on simplified assumptions fail to capture complex correlations in real-world data. Existing learning-based cardinality estimators are typically trained on fixed query distributions and tend to overfit historical predicate combinations and join patterns, leading to severe accuracy degradation when facing unseen workloads.To address this challenge, we propose SRCE, a cardinality estimation framework explicitly designed to be robust to workload shift. SRCE tackles workload shift from both semantic and structural perspectives. It leverages the monotonicity property of query predicates to generate logic-consistent supervision signals, enabling low-cost training data augmentation without additional query executions and improving generalization to unseen predicate combinations. Additionally, SRCE employs graph convolutional networks to model join structures and initializes join node with histogram-based statistics, allowing the estimator to generalize across previously unseen join patterns. To further enhance the model’s robustness, a self-attention mechanism is introduced to perform query-context-aware, dimension-wise reweighting of the concatenated query representation. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that SRCE consistently outperforms existing methods, delivering superior estimation accuracy and query performance across both conventional and workload-shifted scenarios.

AI.tldr: SRCE是一个针对工作负载偏移设计的基数估计框架，通过语义和结构两个角度提升对未见查询的泛化能力，在传统和偏移场景下都优于现有方法。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个对工作负载偏移具有鲁棒性的基数估计框架？
AI.motivation: 传统基于简化假设的方法无法捕捉真实数据的复杂相关性，现有基于学习的基数估计器通常在固定查询分布上训练，容易过拟合历史谓词组合和连接模式，在面对未见工作负载时准确性严重下降。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 查询谓词的单调性属性用于生成逻辑一致的监督信号；2. 图卷积网络用于建模连接结构；3. 自注意力机制进行查询上下文感知的维度重加权。
AI.method: SRCE框架：1) 利用谓词单调性进行低成本训练数据增强；2) 使用图卷积网络建模连接结构，并用基于直方图的统计初始化连接节点；3) 引入自注意力机制对连接后的查询表示进行维度重加权。
AI.findings: 在真实世界基准测试上的广泛实验表明，SRCE在传统和负载偏移场景下都持续优于现有方法，提供更优的估计准确性和查询性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个从语义和结构两个角度处理工作负载偏移的统一框架；2. 将谓词单调性属性用于生成逻辑一致的监督信号；3. 结合图卷积网络和自注意力机制提升对未见连接模式的泛化能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 无需额外查询执行的低成本训练数据增强方法；2. 在实际数据库系统中可部署的鲁棒基数估计器；3. 在传统和负载偏移场景下都能提升查询优化性能。

title: Green Product Platform: An Experimental Evaluation of Cross-Device User Experience
affiliations: Abu Dhabi University

detail.title: Green Product Platform: An Experimental Evaluation of Cross-Device User Experience
detail.abstract: This study assesses a new online marketplace for eco-friendly products in the UAE, using human–computer interaction and usability testing. The platform connects nurseries, gardeners, and environmentally aware consumers to promote sustainable consumption through digital transformation. Guided by design thinking, the research adopted a user-focused approach, employing empathy mapping, persona creation, and iterative prototyping to address issues in accessing green products. Fourteen participants completed five main tasks—registration, login, creating a listing, searching for products, and engaging in events—on both mobile and desktop devices in a within-subjects experiment on Maze.co. Analysis of task completion times and error rates with ANOVA and t-tests showed no significant performance differences between devices (p > .05), indicating consistent usability across platforms. A follow-up user experience survey reported a moderate satisfaction score (average = 3.57/5) and identified areas for enhancement in Navigation and visual design. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of responsive, eco-friendly marketplace design and support the use of design thinking for culturally adapting sustainable commerce solutions. By providing empirical evidence that usability remains consistent across devices and highlighting key user experience improvements, this research offers practical guidance for creating accessible, culturally aware environmental marketplaces in emerging green economy settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了阿联酋一个新型环保产品在线市场平台，采用人机交互和可用性测试方法。研究发现该平台在移动端和桌面端具有一致的可用性，用户体验满意度中等，并识别了导航和视觉设计方面的改进空间。
AI.research_question: 在阿联酋文化背景下，新型环保产品在线市场平台在不同设备（移动端vs桌面端）上的可用性表现如何？用户体验满意度如何？
AI.motivation: 推动阿联酋可持续消费的数字转型，解决环保产品获取困难的问题，连接苗圃、园丁和环保意识消费者，促进绿色经济发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人机交互理论、可用性测试理论、设计思维方法论（共情地图、用户画像、迭代原型设计）、响应式设计理论。
AI.method: 采用用户中心的设计方法，在Maze.co平台上进行被试内实验，14名参与者分别在移动和桌面设备上完成5个主要任务（注册、登录、创建列表、搜索产品、参与活动）。使用ANOVA和t检验分析任务完成时间和错误率，并通过用户体验调查收集满意度数据。
AI.findings: 1. 移动端和桌面端在任务完成时间和错误率上没有显著差异（p > .05），表明跨平台可用性一致；2. 用户体验满意度中等（平均3.57/5分）；3. 导航和视觉设计是需要改进的主要领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为设计思维在文化适应性可持续商业解决方案中的应用提供了实证支持；2. 验证了响应式环保市场设计的有效性；3. 为新兴绿色经济环境中的跨设备可用性研究提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为创建可访问、文化敏感的环保市场平台提供实用指导；2. 识别了具体的用户体验改进领域（导航和视觉设计）；3. 为环保产品在线市场的开发者和设计者提供了跨设备一致性设计的实证证据。

title: Risk Budgeting with Fractional Generalized Hyperbolic Innovations: Evidence from DJIA High-Frequency Data
affiliations: Louisiana State University Shreveport

detail.title: Risk Budgeting with Fractional Generalized Hyperbolic Innovations: Evidence from DJIA High-Frequency Data
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a fractional generalized hyperbolic (fGH) ARMA-GARCH model to capture long-range dependence, fat tails, and volatility clustering in high-frequency returns. Using one-minute data for the 30 DJIA constituents, we find pervasive long-memory (H > 0.5) across 29 stocks, with Information Technology exhibiting the strongest persistence. The fGH model significantly outperforms non-fractional alternatives in goodness-of-fit tests. Furthermore, an AVaR-based risk budgeting framework is developed, demonstrating that AVaRminimizing portfolios achieve superior risk-adjusted performance (STARR ratio) compared to VaR-minimizing and equally weighted benchmarks. Our results highlight the importance of accounting for long-range dependence in intra-day risk management and portfolio construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分数阶广义双曲ARMA-GARCH模型，用于捕捉高频收益率的长记忆性、厚尾和波动率聚类特征。基于道琼斯30只成分股的1分钟数据，发现29只股票存在普遍的长记忆性(H>0.5)，信息技术板块持续性最强。该模型在拟合优度检验中显著优于非分数阶替代模型。此外，开发了基于AVaR的风险预算框架，证明AVaR最小化组合相比VaR最小化和等权重基准具有更优的风险调整绩效(STARR比率)。
AI.research_question: 如何有效建模高频金融收益率的长记忆性、厚尾和波动率聚类特征？分数阶广义双曲ARMA-GARCH模型在捕捉这些特征方面效果如何？基于AVaR的风险预算框架在日内风险管理和投资组合构建中是否优于传统方法？
AI.motivation: 高频金融数据通常表现出长记忆性、厚尾分布和波动率聚类等复杂特征，传统模型难以同时捕捉这些特性。现有风险管理方法如VaR在极端风险度量方面存在不足，需要更精确的模型来支持日内风险管理和投资组合优化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分数阶积分理论、广义双曲分布理论、ARMA-GARCH模型框架、风险价值(VaR)和平均风险价值(AVaR)理论、风险预算理论、投资组合优化理论。
AI.method: 提出分数阶广义双曲ARMA-GARCH模型；使用道琼斯30只成分股的1分钟高频数据；采用赫斯特指数检验长记忆性；进行模型拟合优度比较；构建AVaR最小化投资组合；计算STARR比率评估风险调整绩效；与VaR最小化和等权重基准进行比较。
AI.findings: 1) 29/30只股票存在显著长记忆性(H>0.5)，信息技术板块持续性最强；2) 分数阶广义双曲ARMA-GARCH模型在拟合优度检验中显著优于非分数阶模型；3) AVaR最小化投资组合相比VaR最小化和等权重基准具有更高的STARR比率，风险调整绩效更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出分数阶广义双曲ARMA-GARCH模型，统一处理长记忆性、厚尾和波动率聚类；2) 扩展分数阶积分在金融高频数据建模中的应用；3) 建立基于AVaR的风险预算框架，完善极端风险管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为高频交易和日内风险管理提供更精确的建模工具；2) 证明考虑长记忆性对投资组合优化的实际价值；3) 提供AVaR最小化策略的实证支持，帮助机构投资者改进风险管理和资产配置。

title: Who killed business dynamism in the U.S.?
affiliations: Department of Economics and Management, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Confindustria - Assolombarda

detail.title: Who killed business dynamism in the U.S.?
detail.abstract: We address three symptoms of the decline of business dynamism: entry rate decline, increase in firms’ productivity dispersion, fall in new entrants’ relative size. Productivity shocks favoring incumbents drive the entry decline. Increased productivity dispersion was the consequence of a combination of adverse(favourable) productivity shocks to potential entrants(incumbents). Shocks to fixed costs, markups and the efficiency distribution of firms rationalize the falling relative size of new entrants. Estimated TFP dynamics depend on the tension between the slowdown of new entrants’ efficiency growth and the technological improvements of incumbent firms.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了商业活力下降的三个症状：企业进入率下降、企业生产率离散度增加、新进入者相对规模下降。研究发现生产率冲击有利于在位企业导致进入率下降；生产率离散度增加是潜在进入者面临不利冲击与在位企业面临有利冲击共同作用的结果；固定成本、加成率和企业效率分布的冲击解释了新进入者相对规模下降。估计的全要素生产率动态取决于新进入者效率增长放缓与在位企业技术进步之间的张力。
AI.research_question: 什么因素导致了商业活力的下降，具体表现为企业进入率下降、企业生产率离散度增加以及新进入者相对规模下降？
AI.motivation: 近年来观察到商业活力下降的现象，表现为企业进入率下降、企业间生产率差异扩大以及新进入企业相对于在位企业的规模缩小。理解这些现象背后的驱动因素对于制定促进竞争和经济增长的政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业动态理论框架，考虑生产率冲击、固定成本、加成率和企业效率分布等因素对企业进入、退出和增长的影响。分析在位企业与新进入企业之间的互动关系。
AI.method: 理论建模与实证估计相结合的方法。构建包含企业异质性的动态模型，通过模型校准和参数估计来解释观察到的商业活力下降现象。
AI.findings:
1. 有利于在位企业的生产率冲击是导致企业进入率下降的主要原因
2. 生产率离散度增加是潜在进入者面临不利冲击与在位企业面临有利冲击共同作用的结果
3. 固定成本、加成率和企业效率分布的冲击解释了新进入者相对规模下降
4. 全要素生产率动态取决于新进入者效率增长放缓与在位企业技术进步之间的张力
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提供了理解商业活力下降现象的统一理论框架
2. 区分了不同类型冲击对企业动态的不同影响
3. 揭示了新进入者与在位企业之间效率动态的相互作用机制
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了针对不同商业活力问题的干预方向
2. 帮助识别影响企业进入和竞争的关键障碍
3. 为促进创新和经济增长的政策设计提供理论依据

title: Using wavelets transformation window scanning signal algorithm to determine the optimal number of neurons and layers in an Artificial Neural Network
affiliations: Al-Istiqlal University, Voronezh State Technical University and Al-Istiqlal University

detail.title: Using wavelets transformation window scanning signal algorithm to determine the optimal number of neurons and layers in an Artificial Neural Network
detail.abstract: Determining the optimal number of neurons and layers in an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) remains a largely heuristic and computationally expensive process, commonly addressed through trial-and-error, pruning, or automated search strategies. The current paper introduces a new signal-driven method that uses wavelet transformation along with window-based scanning of the input features as a tool to lead the principle design of ANN architectures. The approach proposed by the authors first takes into account the multi-scale structural complexity of the input signal in the wavelet domain, then, it extracts the localized frequency and variation characteristics that inform the required network depth and width directly. The window scanning technique allows for the identification of complexity variations throughout the signal, hence leading to the selection of the architecture according to the content of the data instead of the empirical tuning. Thereby, the proposed framework is distinctly different from the traditional architecture selection methods, as it actively links signal complexity to network capacity thus providing the architecture determination that is transparent, reproducible, and inexpensive in terms of computation power. Experimental results conducted on benchmark datasets reveal that networks designed by this method obtain competitive accuracy and generalization performance along with the reduction of architectural redundancy. Therefore, the authors conclude that the wavelet-guided architectural design is a very effective alternative to the heuristic-based ANN configuration and moreover, it is the first step in the data-aware neural networks development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于小波变换和窗口扫描的信号驱动方法，用于指导人工神经网络架构设计，通过分析输入信号的多尺度结构复杂度直接确定网络深度和宽度，避免了传统启发式方法的计算成本。
AI.research_question: 如何基于输入信号的固有特性（而非经验调参）来确定人工神经网络的最优架构（神经元数量和层数）？
AI.motivation: 当前ANN架构设计主要依赖启发式方法（试错、剪枝、自动搜索），这些方法计算成本高、缺乏透明度且难以复现，需要一种更系统、数据驱动的方法来连接信号复杂度和网络容量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 小波变换理论：用于分析信号的多尺度结构复杂度；2. 信号处理与神经网络容量关系：信号复杂度与所需网络深度/宽度的理论联系；3. 数据感知神经网络设计框架。
AI.method: 1. 对输入特征进行小波变换，分析多尺度结构复杂度；2. 使用窗口扫描技术提取局部频率和变化特征；3. 基于提取的特征直接确定网络深度和宽度；4. 在基准数据集上进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 实验结果表明，通过该方法设计的网络在基准数据集上获得了有竞争力的准确率和泛化性能，同时减少了架构冗余，计算成本显著降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了信号复杂度与神经网络容量之间的理论联系；2. 提出了数据感知神经网络设计的新框架；3. 为信号驱动的架构选择提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一种透明、可复现、计算成本低的ANN架构设计方法；2. 减少了架构冗余，提高了设计效率；3. 为实际应用中的神经网络配置提供了实用工具。

title: Optimal Place-Based Policy with Endogenous Moving Costs: Lessons from UK De-industrialisation
affiliations: London School of Economics

detail.title: Optimal Place-Based Policy with Endogenous Moving Costs: Lessons from UK De-industrialisation
detail.abstract: House-price divergence erodes home equity in declining regions, raising effective moving costs and collapsing migration responsiveness precisely when it is most needed. We develop a dynamic framework in which this process generates two state-dependent thresholds. The first, a policy ranking threshold Θ∗, identifies when capital subsidies (moving jobs to workers) dominate migration assistance (moving workers to jobs); the second, a stability threshold Pˆ, identifies when falling house prices trigger an instability cascade that makes delayed intervention exponentially more expensive. High-productivity, capability-aligned job creation dominates low-productivity alternatives in total social cost—but only if implemented before the cascade activates. Calibrating to UK deindustrialisation (1979–2024), Teesside crossed both thresholds around 1985–87, exactly when migration responsiveness collapsed empirically. The same intervention costing £150m before threshold crossing cost £450m five years later. Quantity-focused policies imposed welfare losses of approximately £1.2bn (NPV) relative to a capability-aligned R&D alternative. All major UK lagging regions currently exhibit Θ∗< 1, yet “Levelling Up” continues to prioritise employment quantity over job quality, risking a repeat of these errors.

AI.tldr: 房价分化侵蚀衰退地区的房屋净值，增加有效迁移成本，导致迁移响应性在需要时崩溃。本文开发动态框架，识别两个状态依赖阈值：政策排序阈值Θ∗（确定何时资本补贴优于迁移援助）和稳定性阈值Pˆ（确定何时房价下跌触发不稳定级联）。研究发现，高生产率、能力匹配的就业创造在总社会成本上优于低生产率替代方案，但必须在级联激活前实施。基于英国去工业化（1979-2024）的校准显示，蒂赛德地区在1985-87年跨越两个阈值，干预成本从1.5亿英镑增至4.5亿英镑。数量导向政策相对于能力匹配的研发替代方案造成约12亿英镑福利损失。
AI.research_question: 房价分化如何影响区域间迁移响应性？在区域衰退背景下，何时应该采用资本补贴（将工作岗位带到工人所在地）而非迁移援助（将工人带到工作岗位所在地）？房价下跌何时会触发不稳定级联，使延迟干预成本呈指数增长？
AI.motivation: 房价分化侵蚀衰退地区的房屋净值，增加有效迁移成本，导致迁移响应性在需要时崩溃。这种现象在区域衰退时尤为严重，但现有政策往往忽视这一机制。英国"升级计划"继续优先考虑就业数量而非就业质量，可能重复历史错误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态框架包含两个状态依赖阈值：1) 政策排序阈值Θ∗，确定资本补贴与迁移援助的相对优势；2) 稳定性阈值Pˆ，识别房价下跌触发不稳定级联的临界点。框架强调能力匹配的就业创造与低生产率替代方案的成本差异。
AI.method: 理论模型开发结合实证校准。使用英国去工业化时期（1979-2024）数据，特别是蒂赛德地区案例进行校准。分析迁移响应性崩溃的时间点与阈值跨越的关系，量化不同政策干预的成本差异。
AI.findings: 1) 蒂赛德地区在1985-87年跨越两个阈值，与迁移响应性崩溃时间一致；2) 阈值跨越前1.5亿英镑的干预成本在五年后增至4.5亿英镑；3) 数量导向政策相对于能力匹配的研发替代方案造成约12亿英镑净现值福利损失；4) 英国所有主要落后地区目前都显示Θ∗<1，表明资本补贴应优先于迁移援助。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出包含房价分化、房屋净值和迁移成本的动态框架；2) 识别两个关键阈值（Θ∗和Pˆ）及其政策含义；3) 阐明不稳定级联机制如何使延迟干预成本呈指数增长；4) 建立能力匹配就业创造的理论优势条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供评估干预时机的工具；2) 显示早期干预的成本效益优势；3) 证明高生产率、能力匹配的就业创造优于低生产率替代方案；4) 警示英国"升级计划"继续优先就业数量而非质量的风险；5) 提供量化评估框架，避免重复历史错误。

title: Does Flood Insurance Help Neighborhoods Recover from Flooding?
affiliations: and University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Department of Agricultural and Consumer Economics

detail.title: Does Flood Insurance Help Neighborhoods Recover from Flooding?
detail.abstract: This study explores the impact of flood insurance on post-flooding housing prices. Using a shift-share instrumental variable approach that exploits peers’ flood exposure, we find that a $1,000 increase in flood insurance claims per single-family housing unit in the census-tract boosts housing prices by 1.38% after Hurricane Harvey in Houston, roughly $3,197 based on average housing values. While the median homeowner in flooded neighborhoods sees a 1.9% price decline after flooding, households in neighborhoods at the 75th percentile of flood insurance claims experience no such decrease. Moreover, homes that are less likely to be insured benefit from positive spillover effects and disadvantaged neighborhoods experience greater benefits from flood insurance claims. We also find suggestive evidence that well-insured tracts have fewer foreclosed properties and more home renovation. The increase in capitalized housing values represents approximately 50% of the total amount paid out in Harvey-related claims by the National Flood Insurance Program (FEMA).

AI.tldr: 该研究使用工具变量方法发现，洪水保险索赔能显著提升飓风哈维后休斯顿的房价，每千美元索赔使房价上涨1.38%。虽然被淹社区中位数房价下跌，但保险索赔高的社区避免了下跌。保险不足的房屋和弱势社区从保险溢出效应中获益更大。
AI.research_question: 洪水保险对灾后房价有何影响？保险索赔如何影响不同社区和房屋类型的房价变化？
AI.motivation: 理解洪水保险在灾后恢复中的作用，特别是保险如何影响房价这一重要资产价值，以及保险效应在不同社区间的分布差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于保险经济学、资产定价理论和邻里效应理论，研究保险索赔对房价的资本化效应和溢出效应。
AI.method: 采用shift-share工具变量方法，利用同伴洪水暴露作为工具变量，分析飓风哈维后休斯顿洪水保险索赔对房价的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 每千美元洪水保险索赔使房价上涨1.38%（约3197美元）；2) 被淹社区中位数房价下跌1.9%，但保险索赔高的社区避免了下跌；3) 保险不足的房屋和弱势社区获益更大；4) 保险充足的社区止赎房产更少，房屋翻新更多；5) 房价资本化增值约为FEMA索赔支付总额的50%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了洪水保险对房价的资本化效应；2) 发现了保险的邻里溢出效应；3) 提供了保险在不同社会经济群体中分布差异的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者设计更有效的洪水保险计划提供依据；2) 帮助理解保险在灾后恢复中的经济价值；3) 为弱势社区获得保险支持提供政策建议。

title: CLIP-PING: Lightweight CLIP Models with Proximus Intrinsic Neighbors Guidance for Resource-Constrained Vision-Language Systems
affiliations: Kyung Hee University - Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Kyung Hee University - Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Kyung Hee University - Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Kyung Hee University and Kyung Hee University - Department of Computer Science and Engineering

detail.title: CLIP-PING: Lightweight CLIP Models with Proximus Intrinsic Neighbors Guidance for Resource-Constrained Vision-Language Systems
detail.abstract: Beyond the success of Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP), recent trends have increasingly marked a shift toward lightweight vision-language models for resource-constrained systems. However, such models often exhibit suboptimal performance when relying solely on a single image-text contrastive objective, spotlighting the need for more effective training mechanisms that guarantee robust cross-modal feature alignment. In this work, we propose CLIP-PING: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training with Proximus Intrinsic Neighbors Guidance, a novel yet simple and efficient training paradigm designed to improve the performance of lightweight vision-language models with minimal computational overhead and lower data demands. Specifically, CLIP-PING bootstraps unimodal features extracted from arbitrary pre-trained encoders to leverage intrinsic guidance of proximus neighbor samples, i.e., nearest-neighbors (NN) and cross nearest-neighbors (XNN). We find that the additional contrastive supervision induced by these neighbors substantially strengthens cross-modal alignment, enabling lightweight models to learn more generic features with enriched semantic diversity. Extensive experiments reveal that CLIP-PING notably surpasses its peers in zero-shot generalization and cross-modal retrieval tasks. In particular, a 5.5% improvement on zero-shot ImageNet1K classification, along with gains of 10.7% image-to-text (I2T) and 5.7% text-to-image (T2I) on Flickr30K retrieval, compared to the original CLIP when using ViT-XS image encoder trained on 3 million (image, text) pairs. Moreover, CLIP-PING showcases strong downstream transferability under the linear evaluation protocol across multiple image classification benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CLIP-PING提出了一种新颖的轻量级视觉语言模型训练范式，通过利用邻近样本的内在指导（最近邻和交叉最近邻）来增强跨模态特征对齐，显著提升了轻量级模型的性能，同时保持低计算开销和数据需求。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种高效且有效的训练机制，以提升轻量级视觉语言模型在资源受限系统中的跨模态特征对齐性能？
AI.motivation: 随着CLIP的成功，轻量级视觉语言模型在资源受限系统中越来越受关注。然而，仅依赖单一图像-文本对比目标的轻量级模型通常表现不佳，需要更有效的训练机制来保证稳健的跨模态特征对齐。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于对比学习理论，特别是CLIP框架，结合邻近样本的内在指导机制，利用最近邻（NN）和交叉最近邻（XNN）样本来增强特征表示学习。
AI.method: CLIP-PING训练范式：从任意预训练编码器中提取单模态特征，利用邻近样本的内在指导（最近邻和交叉最近邻），通过额外的对比监督来增强跨模态对齐。
AI.findings: 1. CLIP-PING在零样本泛化和跨模态检索任务中显著优于同类方法；2. 在ImageNet1K零样本分类上提升5.5%；3. 在Flickr30K检索任务中，图像到文本提升10.7%，文本到图像提升5.7%；4. 在线性评估协议下展现出强大的下游可迁移性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了利用邻近样本内在指导的新训练范式；2. 扩展了对比学习理论，通过NN和XNN增强特征对齐；3. 为轻量级视觉语言模型训练提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了CLIP-PING训练方法，显著提升轻量级模型性能；2. 实现了低计算开销和数据需求下的高效训练；3. 在多个基准测试中验证了方法的有效性；4. 为资源受限系统提供了实用的轻量级视觉语言模型解决方案。

title: Bioleaching of critical raw materials from bauxite residue with Aspergillus sp
affiliations: Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Budapest University of Technology and Economics, University of Applied Sciences and Arts Northwestern Switzerland, Budapest University of Technology and Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Bioleaching of critical raw materials from bauxite residue with Aspergillus sp
detail.abstract: Bauxite residue (red mud) represents a promising secondary resource for critical raw materials (CRMs). Biohydrometallurgy offers a potentially more sustainable alternative to conventional hydro- and pyrometallurgical routes for CRM recovery. In this study, an Aspergillus sp. was used to bioleach CRMs from bauxite residue (BR) under energy-efficient conditions, including a relatively low temperature (22 °C), a short contact time (5 days), and high pulp densities (up to 20 w/w%). During one-step bioleaching, fungal activity lowered the pH to 3.7‐4.8, depending on the BR concentration. The highest recovery efficiencies were achieved at 1% BR, reaching 77% Al, 47% Ti, 50% V, 42% Ga, 61% Y, 65% Zr, 20% La, 18% Ce, and 35% Nd. Increasing the BR concentration led to higher CRM concentrations in the leachate but reduced overall recovery efficiency. Vanadium extraction was maximised at 20 w/w% BR, yielding 48 mg/L in the leachate, corresponding to an 18% leaching efficiency. Ecotoxicological assessment revealed increased toxicity of the leaching residue obtained at 20% BR compared with the original material. Washing further increased residue toxicity and generated a toxic washing effluent, indicating that alternative post-treatment strategies are required. Overall, the results demonstrate that low-temperature, short-term fungal bioleaching at lower pulp densities can provide an environmentally favourable approach for CRM recovery from bauxite residue.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用曲霉菌在低温(22°C)、短时间(5天)和高矿浆密度(最高20%)条件下从赤泥中生物浸出关键原材料。最佳回收效率在1%赤泥浓度时达到，可回收多种金属元素。研究发现高浓度赤泥会降低回收效率并增加浸出残渣的生态毒性。
AI.research_question: 曲霉菌在低温、短时间、高矿浆密度条件下从赤泥中生物浸出关键原材料的效率和环境影响如何？
AI.motivation: 赤泥作为关键原材料的二次资源具有重要价值，生物湿法冶金相比传统方法更具可持续性，但需要评估其在实际条件下的效率和环境影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生物湿法冶金理论、真菌生物浸出机制、关键原材料回收技术、生态毒性评估框架
AI.method: 使用曲霉菌进行一步生物浸出实验，在22°C、5天接触时间、不同赤泥浓度(1-20%)条件下进行，测量pH变化、金属回收效率，并对浸出残渣进行生态毒性评估。
AI.findings: 1%赤泥浓度时回收效率最高：Al 77%、Ti 47%、V 50%、Ga 42%、Y 61%、Zr 65%、La 20%、Ce 18%、Nd 35%；真菌活动使pH降至3.7-4.8；赤泥浓度增加提高浸出液金属浓度但降低回收效率；20%浓度时钒提取最佳(48mg/L, 18%效率)；高浓度赤泥浸出残渣生态毒性增加，洗涤进一步增加毒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 验证了真菌在低温、短时间条件下从赤泥中生物浸出关键原材料的可行性；2) 揭示了赤泥浓度对回收效率和生态毒性的影响规律；3) 建立了真菌生物浸出过程的pH调控机制与金属回收效率的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一种环境友好的关键原材料回收方法；2) 确定了最佳操作条件(低矿浆密度)；3) 揭示了洗涤处理的环境风险，指出需要替代的后处理策略；4) 为工业规模应用提供了技术参数和风险评估依据。

title: Modeling Trust in Central Bank Communication under Uncertainty: A Machine Learning–Driven Fractal Fuzzy Decision Support Mechanism
affiliations: Istanbul Medipol University, Istanbul Medipol University, Istanbul Medipol University, Istanbul Medipol University, Istanbul Medipol University and Istanbul Medipol University

detail.title: Modeling Trust in Central Bank Communication under Uncertainty: A Machine Learning–Driven Fractal Fuzzy Decision Support Mechanism
detail.abstract: This study focuses on prioritizing strategies to enhance the impact of central bank communication policies on market confidence. The fundamental problem in this area is that, despite communication playing a critical role in monetary policy effectiveness and confidence building, it has not been clearly defined which communication dimensions and strategies should be prioritized. The current literature mostly emphasizes the general importance of communication, but studies that comparatively and quantitatively analyze the relative effects of different communication strategies are quite limited. The aim of this study is to identify the most prioritized criteria and strategies to strengthen the impact of central bank communication policy on market confidence and to analyze this process within the framework of a holistic decision-making model supported by artificial intelligence. To this end, a unique multi-criteria decision-making model based on Koch Snowflake fuzzy sets is proposed. In the model, 12 criteria and 6 communication strategies, determined through a literature review, are evaluated based on the opinions of 10 experts. The importance weights of the experts were calculated using machine learning techniques, and the criterion weights were calculated using the SIWEC method; the RATGOS approach was used to rank the strategies. The robustness of the results was tested using RAM and MUNRA methods. The findings indicate that the contribution to the perception of political independence and the clarity of forward guidance are the most influential criteria for trust.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于科赫雪花模糊集的多准则决策模型，识别增强央行沟通政策对市场信心影响的最优先策略。研究发现政治独立性的感知贡献和前向指引的清晰度是最重要的信任影响因素。
AI.research_question: 哪些沟通维度和策略应该被优先考虑，以增强央行沟通政策对市场信心的影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管沟通在货币政策有效性和信心建设中起关键作用，但现有文献大多强调沟通的一般重要性，缺乏对不同沟通策略相对效果的比较和定量分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多准则决策理论、模糊集理论（科赫雪花模糊集）、人工智能支持的决策模型、央行沟通理论
AI.method: 基于科赫雪花模糊集的独特多准则决策模型，包含12个标准和6个沟通策略，通过10位专家意见评估，使用机器学习技术计算专家权重，SIWEC方法计算标准权重，RATGOS方法排序策略，RAM和MUNRA方法测试结果稳健性。
AI.findings: 对政治独立性的感知贡献和前向指引的清晰度是影响信任的最重要标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出基于科赫雪花模糊集的新型多准则决策模型；2) 将人工智能技术整合到央行沟通策略评估中；3) 为央行沟通研究提供定量比较分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为央行决策者提供沟通策略优先排序的实用工具；2) 识别最有效的沟通维度（政治独立性和前向指引清晰度）；3) 提供基于专家意见和人工智能的决策支持系统。

title: Do shifts in green energy fund flows affect financial markets and economic growth?
affiliations: University of Sussex, Bank of Japan and Vlerick Business School

detail.title: Do shifts in green energy fund flows affect financial markets and economic growth?
detail.abstract: Why has financing related to green energy funds progressed more slowly than needed to address climate concerns, and does accelerating this transition risk undermining financial markets or economic growth? Using data on US green and brown energy funds, we examine the dynamics of capital reallocation between these two segments. We find a time-varying shift from brown to green energy investments, largely influenced by policy-driven climate news rather than long-term temperature trends. The speed of this reallocation is closely linked to changes in US climate policy. Moreover, while climate news shocks tend to depress stock returns and industrial production, these effects are significantly moderated by the presence of green energy funds, which act as a stabilizing buffer. Overall, our findings suggest that accelerated green energy fund flows can enhance both financial stability and real economic performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用美国绿色和棕色能源基金数据，发现资本从棕色能源向绿色能源的再分配受气候政策新闻驱动而非长期温度趋势影响，且绿色能源基金能缓冲气候新闻对股市和工业生产的负面影响，加速绿色能源基金流动可增强金融稳定和实体经济表现。
AI.research_question: 为什么绿色能源相关融资进展缓慢？加速绿色转型是否会破坏金融市场或经济增长？资本在绿色和棕色能源之间的再分配动态如何？
AI.motivation: 应对气候变化需要加速绿色能源融资，但现实中进展缓慢，且存在对金融稳定和经济增长的担忧，需要实证研究资本再分配动态及其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资本再分配理论、政策影响理论、金融市场稳定理论，探讨气候政策新闻如何驱动资本流动，以及绿色基金如何缓冲负面冲击。
AI.method: 使用美国绿色和棕色能源基金数据，分析资本再分配动态，考察政策驱动气候新闻与长期温度趋势的影响，并检验绿色基金对股市回报和工业生产的缓冲作用。
AI.findings: 1. 资本从棕色向绿色能源的再分配随时间变化，主要由政策驱动气候新闻而非长期温度趋势影响；2. 再分配速度与美国气候政策变化密切相关；3. 气候新闻冲击会降低股票回报和工业生产，但绿色能源基金显著缓解这些负面影响；4. 加速绿色能源基金流动可增强金融稳定和实体经济表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了气候政策新闻而非长期环境趋势是驱动资本再分配的关键因素；2. 提出了绿色能源基金作为金融市场稳定缓冲机制的理论机制；3. 丰富了资本再分配与环境政策互动理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了加速绿色转型不会损害金融稳定的实证依据；2. 表明绿色基金发展有助于缓解气候政策冲击对经济的负面影响；3. 为投资者提供了绿色投资具有稳定作用的决策参考。

title: Environmental Pressure Measurement: A Composite and Discriminant Approach
affiliations: University of Genoa, University of Genoa and University of Genoa

detail.title: Environmental Pressure Measurement: A Composite and Discriminant Approach
detail.abstract: This paper presents a planning-focused statistical approach to the measurement and interpretation of environmental pressure in diverse economic systems. The paper concentrates on OECD and BRICS nations during the period 2000-2023, using a distance-based composite indicator and multivariate classification methods to inform evidence-based environmental and industrial planning. Environmental pressure is assessed by a non-compensatory composite index based on carbon dioxide, methane, and nitrate emissions, reflecting structural stress generated by energy consumption, industry, and agriculture. The composite index facilitates longitudinal analysis and cross-national comparison, offering a composite yet policy-useful measure of aggregate environmental pressure. To provide a dynamic perspective, Linear Discriminant Analysis is used to assess whether emission structures distinguish statistically advanced and emerging economies and to specify transition or hybrid patterns. The findings indicate the persistent diversity of institutional categories and the increasingly blurred line between OECD and BRICS nations. Misclassifications are interpreted not as model errors, but as statistically meaningful signals of structural transition and partial convergence in emission profiles. This evidence challenges rigid development-based classifications and supports a continuum-based interpretation of environmental pressure. From a socio-economic planning perspective, the proposed framework enhances statistical measurement for sustainability by linking composite indicators with structural diagnostics. It provides a decision-support tool for identifying transition cases, monitoring convergence processes, and designing differentiated environmental policies aligned with country-specific emission structures rather than institutional labels alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于规划的统计方法，用于测量和解释不同经济体系的环境压力。研究聚焦2000-2023年OECD和BRICS国家，使用距离型综合指标和多变量分类方法，为基于证据的环境和工业规划提供支持。
AI.research_question: 如何通过统计方法测量和解释OECD与BRICS国家的环境压力差异？排放结构是否能够区分发达与新兴经济体？是否存在过渡或混合模式？
AI.motivation: 需要超越传统发展分类的刚性框架，提供更细致的环境压力测量方法，以支持差异化的环境政策设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于距离的综合指标理论、非补偿性综合指数方法、线性判别分析理论、结构转型理论、收敛理论。
AI.method: 使用基于二氧化碳、甲烷和硝酸盐排放的非补偿性综合指数；应用线性判别分析评估排放结构差异；采用多变量分类方法分析OECD和BRICS国家2000-2023年的数据。
AI.findings: 制度类别存在持续多样性；OECD与BRICS国家之间的界限日益模糊；误分类不是模型错误，而是结构转型和部分收敛的统计信号；挑战了基于发展的刚性分类。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于连续体的环境压力解释框架；挑战了传统发展分类的刚性假设；建立了综合指标与结构诊断之间的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了决策支持工具，用于识别转型案例、监测收敛过程、设计基于具体国家排放结构而非制度标签的差异化环境政策。

title: The Impact of Global PV Solar Expansion on Gold and Silver Price Dynamics: Machine Learning Forecasts and Economic Implications
affiliations: Universitas Halu Oleo

detail.title: The Impact of Global PV Solar Expansion on Gold and Silver Price Dynamics: Machine Learning Forecasts and Economic Implications
detail.abstract: This study investigates how global photovoltaic (PV) solar expansion shapes gold and silver price dynamics using a novel annual dataset (2000–2024) and a hybrid empirical framework. The analysis integrates standard econometric tools (ADF, Johansen cointegration, panel OLS, Granger causality) with machine learning forecasts (LSTM and XGBoost), interpretability (SHAP), and stress testing to capture both causal channels and predictive performance. The results revealed three main findings. First, the Granger causality tests indicate that cumulative PV capacity significantly influences gold prices at short lags (1–2), while the effect on silver is statistically insignificant, pointing to indirect channels through macroeconomic factors and portfolio rebalancing. Second, panel regressions show that PV-driven silver demand exerts a modest impact on silver prices, whereas macroeconomic factors (the USD index, inflation, and geopolitical risk) remain the dominant drivers for both metals. Third, XGBoost provides superior out-of-sample accuracy compared to LSTM, and SHAP analysis highlights a multi-year lag structure (approximately four years) for the PV capacity effects. Stress testing further indicates that precious metals remain highly sensitive to macro shocks despite structural pressures from PV expansion. This study contributes a unified dataset, documents a causality paradox between PV expansion and precious metals, and demonstrates the practical value of combining machine learning with econometric methods for scenario forecasting. The policy implications include the need for strategic mineral planning, dynamic hedging strategies, and central bank awareness of energy-transition effects on inflation expectations.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用混合实证框架（计量经济学+机器学习）分析全球光伏扩张对金银价格的影响。发现光伏容量短期内影响金价但不直接影响银价，宏观经济因素仍是主要驱动力，XGBoost预测优于LSTM，光伏效应有约4年滞后。
AI.research_question: 全球光伏太阳能扩张如何影响黄金和白银的价格动态？
AI.motivation: 随着全球能源转型加速，光伏太阳能大规模扩张可能通过影响贵金属需求（特别是光伏制造中使用的银）和宏观经济环境，对金银价格产生结构性影响，但这一关系的实证证据尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合传统计量经济学理论（价格形成机制、供需理论）和机器学习预测理论，通过因果检验、面板回归和可解释AI方法分析光伏扩张对贵金属价格的多渠道影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2000-2024年年度数据集，采用混合实证框架：标准计量工具（ADF检验、Johansen协整、面板OLS、格兰杰因果检验）结合机器学习预测（LSTM和XGBoost）、可解释性分析（SHAP）和压力测试。
AI.findings: 1. 光伏容量短期内显著影响金价（滞后1-2年），但对银价直接影响不显著；2. 光伏驱动的银需求对银价影响有限，宏观经济因素（美元指数、通胀、地缘政治风险）仍是主要驱动力；3. XGBoost预测精度优于LSTM，SHAP显示光伏效应有约4年滞后；4. 贵金属对宏观冲击仍高度敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建统一数据集；2. 记录光伏扩张与贵金属之间的"因果悖论"；3. 展示机器学习与计量方法结合在情景预测中的实用价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为战略矿产规划提供依据；2. 建议动态对冲策略；3. 提醒央行关注能源转型对通胀预期的影响。

title: Robust Firm-Level Revenue Forecasting Using Stacked Hybrid Ensemble Frameworks:Evidence from the Semiconductor Industry
affiliations: National Taipei University of Technology, National Taipei University of Technology and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Robust Firm-Level Revenue Forecasting Using Stacked Hybrid Ensemble Frameworks:Evidence from the Semiconductor Industry
detail.abstract: Accurate revenue forecasting is essential for financial planning, resource allocation, and strategic decision-making in the volatile semiconductor industry. This study proposes the Stacked Hybrid Ensemble (SHE) framework, a novel forecasting architecture that integrates long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, Transformer models, and extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) to predict monthly revenue for Taiwan-listed semiconductor firms. Our approach incorporates time series decomposition to analyze trend, seasonality, and residual components, and examines how firm size impacts forecast accuracy. The proposed SHE framework combines stacking ensemble with a dynamic weighting mechanism to adaptively fuse model predictions. Experimental results demonstrate that SHE outperforms all individual models across four error metrics, achieving up to a 35.4% improvement in mean squared error (MSE). Through rigorous statistical validation using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, we confirm that SHE’s performance superiority is systematic and statistically significant (p =1.49×10−8) across all 26 companies, providing high reliability for practical applications. For business practitioners and investors, these findings offer substantial value: (1) financial managers can enhance budgeting accuracy and cash-flow planning; (2) operations directors can improve production scheduling and inventory management; and (3) investors gain more reliable tools for company valuation and risk assessment. The framework’s consistent performance across different firm sizes makes it particularly valuable for portfolio analysis and supply-chain decision-making in the cyclical semiconductor sector.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为堆叠混合集成（SHE）框架的新预测架构，用于预测台湾上市半导体公司的月度营收。该框架整合了LSTM、Transformer和XGBoost模型，通过时间序列分解和动态加权机制，在四个误差指标上均优于所有单个模型，MSE提升高达35.4%。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个有效的预测框架来准确预测台湾上市半导体公司的月度营收，并探究公司规模对预测准确性的影响？
AI.motivation: 在波动性强的半导体行业中，准确的营收预测对于财务规划、资源配置和战略决策至关重要。现有预测方法可能无法充分捕捉该行业的复杂动态特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于集成学习理论，特别是堆叠集成方法，结合深度学习（LSTM、Transformer）和机器学习（XGBoost）模型。同时运用时间序列分解理论分析趋势、季节性和残差成分。
AI.method: 提出堆叠混合集成（SHE）框架，整合LSTM、Transformer和XGBoost模型。采用时间序列分解分析各成分，使用动态加权机制自适应融合模型预测。通过Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行统计验证，涵盖26家台湾上市半导体公司。
AI.findings: SHE框架在所有四个误差指标上均优于所有单个模型，MSE提升高达35.4%。统计检验表明SHE的性能优势具有系统性且统计显著（p=1.49×10⁻⁸）。框架在不同公司规模下表现一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新颖的堆叠混合集成框架，将深度学习和传统机器学习模型有机结合。发展了动态加权机制来优化模型融合。验证了集成方法在半导体行业预测中的优越性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 财务管理者可提高预算准确性和现金流规划；2) 运营总监可改进生产调度和库存管理；3) 投资者可获得更可靠的公司估值和风险评估工具；4) 框架在不同规模公司中的一致性能使其特别适用于投资组合分析和供应链决策。

title: The introduction of Japan-made banknotes into Taiwan during Japanese Occupation Time（1895-1945）
affiliations: Wuhan Business University and Kansai University

detail.title: The introduction of Japan-made banknotes into Taiwan during Japanese Occupation Time（1895-1945）
detail.abstract: This study examines the introduction and circulation of Japan-made banknotes in colonial Taiwan during the early years of Japanese rule (1899-1905). Following the establishment of the Bank of Taiwan in 1899, the Japanese government sought to modernize Taiwan's chaotic monetary system through paper currency. Drawing upon primary sources including Taiwan Daily News reports and official Bank of Taiwan documents, we trace banknote design adaptation, printing procedures, transportation logistics, and circulation promotion. Our analysis reveals that banknote circulation expanded from 2,276,411 yen (September 1900) to 6,214,372 yen (September 1905), representing a 173% increase. By 1901, Taiwan Banknotes constituted 59.7% of all currency in circulation. Regional analysis shows significant geographic variation, with Taichung exhibiting the most dramatic increase (from 2.9% to 92.1% between January 1900 and May 1901). These findings illuminate colonial monetary policy implementation and economic integration between Taiwan and Japan.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了日本统治初期（1899-1905年）日本制造纸币在殖民地台湾的引入与流通情况，分析了纸币设计、印刷、运输和流通推广，揭示了殖民货币政策实施和台湾与日本经济整合的过程。
AI.research_question: 日本统治初期（1899-1905年），日本制造纸币在殖民地台湾是如何被引入、流通并影响当地货币体系的？
AI.motivation: 日本政府在1899年设立台湾银行后，试图通过纸币现代化台湾混乱的货币体系，研究这一过程有助于理解殖民货币政策的实施和台湾与日本的经济整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 殖民货币政策理论、货币现代化理论、经济整合理论，以及殖民统治下的金融体系构建理论。
AI.method: 基于《台湾日日新报》报道和台湾银行官方文件等一手资料，采用历史分析方法，追踪纸币设计调整、印刷程序、运输物流和流通推广过程。
AI.findings: 1. 纸币流通量从1900年9月的2,276,411日元增至1905年9月的6,214,372日元，增长173%；2. 1901年台湾银行纸币占流通货币总量的59.7%；3. 区域分析显示显著地理差异，台中地区增长最为显著（1900年1月至1901年5月从2.9%增至92.1%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对殖民货币政策实施机制的理解；2. 揭示了殖民地货币现代化的具体路径；3. 丰富了经济整合理论在殖民金融领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解台湾与日本早期经济关系提供历史视角；2. 为研究殖民金融政策实施提供案例参考；3. 对现代货币政策和区域经济整合研究具有启示意义。

title: Cross-sectoral and spatial impacts of carbon neutrality on China's transport sector emissions: A 31-region CGE analysis
affiliations: China Electric Power Research Institute, Nankai University, Peking University, China Electric Power Research Institute, Tianjin University, Nankai University and Peking University

detail.title: Cross-sectoral and spatial impacts of carbon neutrality on China's transport sector emissions: A 31-region CGE analysis
detail.abstract: The carbon peaking and carbon neutrality strategy is reshaping China’s industrial structure, with profound yet underexplored ripple effects on the transportation industry—a key pillar of the national economy. From the perspective of the industrial chain and regional correlation, this study employs a Computable General Equilibrium (IMED|CGE) model covering 31 Chinese provinces to assess how upstream industrial changes under carbon neutrality policies cascade into the transport sector’s scale, output, and emissions. Combining structural path decomposition, we trace the industrial and spatial pathways through which emission reductions propagate. Findings reveal that carbon neutrality policies trigger systemic shifts in transport demand by restructuring industries and reduce its CO2 emissions by 43.1% in 2060. The policy-induced contraction of energy-intensive sectors, such as coal and steel, leads to a sharp decline in transport inputs for these industries (e.g., by $26.9 billion and $28.3 billion, respectively), directly curtailing high-carbon bulk freight. Conversely, the expansion of low-carbon services stimulates a significant increase in transport demand (by $87.0 billion), fostering a structural shift towards high-value, lower-emission freight. Meanwhile, transport electrification and efficiency gains amplify these effects. Spatially, impacts vary significantly. The transportation sector in energy-exporting provinces (e.g., Shanxi, Inner Mongolia) achieves the most significant emission reductions (up to 78.4%), with core reduction pathways primarily concentrated in upstream production processes (e.g., coal mining). In economically diversified regions (e.g., Guangdong, Chongqing), cuts occur more in downstream consumption, such as reduced transport linked to local construction and services. We recommend that energy-exporting regions prioritize upstream green supply development, while economically advanced areas focus on downstream low-carbon consumption. Synergizing “upstream green supply” with “downstream low-carbon consumption” can drive a comprehensive green transition across China’s transport sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用覆盖中国31个省份的可计算一般均衡模型，分析碳中和政策如何通过产业链和区域关联影响交通运输业。研究发现碳中和政策通过重构产业结构改变运输需求，到206年使交通CO2排放减少43.1%。能源密集型行业收缩减少大宗货运需求，而低碳服务业扩张增加高价值低排放货运需求。空间上，能源输出省份减排主要来自上游生产过程，经济多元化地区减排更多来自下游消费端。
AI.research_question: 碳中和政策如何通过产业链和区域关联影响中国交通运输业的规模、产出和排放？
AI.motivation: 碳达峰和碳中和战略正在重塑中国产业结构，但对作为国民经济支柱的交通运输业产生的连锁效应尚未得到充分探索。需要从产业链和区域关联视角，系统分析上游产业变化如何传导至交通部门。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业链理论、区域关联理论、可计算一般均衡理论、结构路径分解方法
AI.method: 使用覆盖中国31个省份的可计算一般均衡模型（IMED|CGE），结合结构路径分解方法，追踪减排的产业和空间传导路径
AI.findings: 1. 碳中和政策到206年使交通CO2排放减少43.1%；2. 能源密集型行业（煤炭、钢铁）收缩导致运输投入大幅减少（分别减少269亿和283亿美元），直接抑制高碳大宗货运；3. 低碳服务业扩张显著增加运输需求（增加870亿美元），推动向高价值、低排放货运的结构转型；4. 空间差异显著：能源输出省份（山西、内蒙古）减排最多（达78.4%），减排路径集中在上游生产过程；经济多元化地区（广东、重庆）减排更多来自下游消费端
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 从产业链和区域关联视角揭示了碳中和政策对交通运输业的传导机制；2. 通过结构路径分解识别了减排的产业和空间传导路径；3. 为理解环境政策在产业网络中的系统性影响提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供差异化区域策略：能源输出地区应优先发展上游绿色供应链，经济发达地区应聚焦下游低碳消费；2. 提出"上游绿色供应"与"下游低碳消费"协同推进的全面绿色转型路径；3. 为交通运输业低碳转型提供实证依据和决策支持

title: A novel online deep learning regression controller for effective real-time maximum demand reductions using battery energy storage system
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Tunku Abdul Rahman University (UTAR) - Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A novel online deep learning regression controller for effective real-time maximum demand reductions using battery energy storage system
detail.abstract: Maximum demand (MD) is the highest peak demand of all the daily peak demands over a month. Battery energy storage system (BESS) can be used and controlled appropriately to reduce the monthly maximum demands such that customers can reduce their maximum demand charges and power utility companies can defer their network reinforcement and augmentation of generating capacity. It is important to ensure that any technique employed for BESS to reduce MD is consistent and reliable in reducing every single daily peak demand to deliver the financial benefits. An online deep learning regression controller is a new control technique introduced in this paper that is different from conventional methods. This technique operates using its regression ability to generate the best possible threshold in real-time such that BESS supplies real power to the load when the load demand exceeds the threshold. This regression ability is absent in the published BESS controllers. Its regression ability is trained with the historical data and actively updated with its new data by using its online learning feature to capture any long-term changes in the demand due to the human behavioural or climate changes. The performance of the controller is evaluated through simulation and real-world experiment. The simulation studies show that the controller achieves improved performance when benchmarked against other deep learning models and existing controllers with an average maximum demand reduction factor of 75.08%. The DLR controller achieves about 10.89% higher maximum demand reduction than the next closest contender. Furthermore, the experimental results validate its effectiveness, showing an average maximum demand reduction factor of 73.49%. Overall, the online proposed controller effectively reduces maximum demands in both simulation and real-world scenarios, achieving an improvement of 175.42% compared to a battery system with basic scheduling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于在线深度学习的回归控制器，用于电池储能系统(BESS)降低月度最大需求(MD)。该控制器通过实时生成最优阈值，在负载需求超过阈值时供电，相比现有方法能更有效地减少最大需求，平均减少因子达75.08%。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种基于在线深度学习的回归控制器，使电池储能系统能够更有效、可靠地降低月度最大需求？
AI.motivation: 最大需求(MD)是月度内所有日峰值需求中的最高值。降低MD可以帮助客户减少需求费用，同时帮助电力公司推迟网络升级和发电容量扩建。现有BESS控制器缺乏回归能力，无法实时适应需求变化，需要一种更智能、自适应的控制方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 在线深度学习回归理论、电池储能系统控制理论、最大需求管理理论、实时阈值优化理论
AI.method: 提出在线深度学习回归控制器，利用回归能力实时生成最优阈值，当负载需求超过阈值时BESS供电。控制器通过历史数据训练，并利用在线学习功能持续更新以适应长期需求变化。通过仿真和实际实验验证性能。
AI.findings: 仿真结果显示控制器平均最大需求减少因子为75.08%，比次优方法高10.89%。实际实验验证平均减少因子为73.49%。相比基础调度电池系统，改进达175.42%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次将在线深度学习回归应用于BESS最大需求控制；2) 提出实时阈值生成机制；3) 引入自适应学习框架以适应长期需求变化；4) 填补了现有BESS控制器缺乏回归能力的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为客户提供更有效的最大需求减少方案，降低电费成本；2) 帮助电力公司推迟网络投资；3) 控制器具有实际部署可行性；4) 相比现有方法性能显著提升；5) 系统适应性强，能应对行为和气候变化。

title: Beyond arbitrage: How PUE-linked electricity pricing reshapes the selection of data center waste heat recovery strategies
affiliations: Tianjin University, Guangdong University of Technology, Guangdong University of Technology, Guangdong University of Technology, Tianjin University, Tianjin University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Tianjin University and Tianjin University

detail.title: Beyond arbitrage: How PUE-linked electricity pricing reshapes the selection of data center waste heat recovery strategies
detail.abstract: With the rapid development of data centers, efficient waste heat recovery from cooling systems has become increasingly important for energy conservation and carbon reduction. However, under electricity pricing policies linked to Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE), the thermo-economic performance of waste heat recovery systems is fundamentally reshaped, yet remains insufficiently investigated. Against this background, this study examines representative waste heat recovery systems for data centers. Theoretical limits in terms of maximum PUE reduction and power generation profit are first derived, followed by thermodynamic and thermo-economic analyses with PUE-linked penalty pricing explicitly incorporated to quantify the actual energy-saving effects and their influence on the recovery system selection. Finally, Shanghai is adopted as a case study to evaluate the full-year operational performance of different recovery schemes under penalty pricing constraints. Results demonstrate that recovery schemes prioritizing PUE reduction to eliminate penalty costs are superior: in Shanghai, the resulting operating cost savings are nearly three times the power generation profit, with annual cost reduced by up to 27.11% under organic Rankine cycle operation. For newly built data centers, integrating thermal storage at design stage enables simultaneous reductions in PUE and Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE). Overall, this work provides a region-adaptive perspective and practical decision support for selecting waste heat recovery strategies under diverse regional conditions.

AI.tldr: 数据中心废热回收系统在PUE电价政策下的热经济性能分析，发现优先降低PUE以消除惩罚成本的方案更优，在上海案例中运行成本节约是发电利润的近3倍，有机朗肯循环可降低年成本27.11%
AI.research_question: 在PUE关联电价政策下，数据中心废热回收系统的热经济性能如何？不同回收方案在实际运行中的节能效果和系统选择影响因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 数据中心快速发展，冷却系统废热高效回收对节能减碳日益重要，但PUE关联电价政策从根本上重塑了废热回收系统的热经济性能，而这一领域研究不足
AI.theoretical_framework: 热力学分析、热经济分析、PUE关联惩罚定价理论、最大PUE降低和发电利润的理论极限
AI.method: 1. 推导最大PUE降低和发电利润的理论极限；2. 结合PUE关联惩罚定价进行热力学和热经济分析；3. 以上海为案例研究，评估不同回收方案在惩罚定价约束下的全年运行性能
AI.findings: 1. 优先降低PUE以消除惩罚成本的回收方案更优；2. 在上海案例中，运行成本节约是发电利润的近3倍；3. 有机朗肯循环操作下年成本最多降低27.11%；4. 新建数据中心在设计阶段集成储热可同时降低PUE和LCOE
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了PUE关联电价政策下废热回收系统的热经济分析框架；2. 推导了最大PUE降低和发电利润的理论极限；3. 提供了区域适应性视角，为不同区域条件下的废热回收策略选择提供理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为数据中心运营商在选择废热回收策略时提供实际决策支持；2. 识别了优先降低PUE的方案在经济上的优越性；3. 提出了新建数据中心集成储热的设计建议；4. 提供了区域适应性分析框架，适用于不同地区的政策环境

title: PaSTNet: A Multimodal Model for High-resolution Parking Search Time Estimates
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: PaSTNet: A Multimodal Model for High-resolution Parking Search Time Estimates
detail.abstract: Evaluating parking difficulty is critical for urban planning and policy, including parking pricing, demand management, parking facility allocation, and curb space regulation. Reliable estimates of parking difficulty are also essential for commercial applications such as routing and navigation systems. However, accurately estimating parking difficulty at large scale remains challenging for several reasons. First, large-scale parking data are difficult to collect or are commercially restricted. Uncovering parking patterns requires extensive historical data with rich spatial and temporal coverage. Second, parking behavior exhibits substantial spatial heterogeneity due to the combined effects of road characteristics and the surrounding built environment. In this paper, we quantify parking difficulty with parking search time (PST) and propose a multimodal framework - PaSTNet - for estimating PST for each road segment at city scale. PaSTNet integrates a Graph Neural Network (GNN) to capture spatial dependencies in parking behavior. Visual features reflecting curbside and roadway conditions are extracted from satellite imagery using a large-scale pre-trained visual foundation model DINO-v2. A cross-attention module is then employed to fuse visual embeddings with trajectory-based features and road characteristics, enabling the model to jointly learn from network structure and visual context. Experimental results demonstrate that PaSTNet consistently outperforms baseline methods. In addition, this study provides insights into the spatiotemporal distribution of parking difficulty across urban areas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PaSTNet多模态框架，通过图神经网络和视觉特征融合，在城市尺度上估计停车搜索时间，解决了大规模停车数据收集困难和空间异质性挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何在大规模城市尺度上准确估计停车搜索时间（PST），以量化停车难度？
AI.motivation: 停车难度评估对城市规划、政策制定和商业应用至关重要，但大规模准确估计面临数据收集困难和空间异质性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于图神经网络的空间依赖建模、计算机视觉特征提取、多模态特征融合理论。
AI.method: 提出PaSTNet多模态框架：1) 使用GNN捕捉停车行为空间依赖；2) 利用DINO-v2预训练视觉模型从卫星图像提取路缘和道路条件特征；3) 通过交叉注意力模块融合视觉嵌入、轨迹特征和道路特征。
AI.findings: PaSTNet在实验中持续优于基线方法，并揭示了城市区域停车难度的时空分布特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出首个结合GNN和视觉基础模型的多模态停车搜索时间估计框架；2) 开发了融合网络结构和视觉上下文的学习方法；3) 解决了停车行为空间异质性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为城市规划者提供停车难度评估工具；2) 支持停车定价、需求管理和路缘空间规划；3) 为导航系统提供可靠的停车搜索时间估计。

title: Determinants of Women’s Participation in Leadership and Management of Agricultural Cooperatives in Endamohoni, Tigray, Ethiopia
affiliations: Humera Agricultural Research Center - Tigray Agricultural Research Institute, Mekelle University and The Australian National University

detail.title: Determinants of Women’s Participation in Leadership and Management of Agricultural Cooperatives in Endamohoni, Tigray, Ethiopia
detail.abstract: AbstractWomen's participation in all economic, social, and political spheres is crucial for a country’s development. In most developing countries, such as Ethiopia, women’s participation in various managerial activities is low, particularly in leadership and decision-making. The objectives of the study were to assess the governance structure of agricultural cooperatives, examine the extent of participation of women members in leadership positions, and identify the factors that affect women’s participation in agricultural cooperative leadership. A multi-stage sampling procedure was followed for the selection of sample women members.  Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and an ordered logit regression model. The participation of women in each leadership position should ideally be 50% or a minimum of 30%. However, for the study cooperatives, it was 11.11%. 40% women never participated in the main cooperative activities. Findings from the ordered logistics show that age, experience and education level of the household head and the household’s family size, non-farm income earning, livestock endowment, farm land endowment, and home distance to cooperative were found to be the determinant factors that affect the level of women’s participation in management and leadership of cooperatives.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了埃塞俄比亚农业合作社的治理结构，考察了女性成员在领导职位中的参与程度，并识别了影响女性参与农业合作社领导的因素。研究发现女性领导参与率仅为11.11%，远低于理想水平，并确定了年龄、教育、家庭规模等多个影响因素。
AI.research_question: 农业合作社的治理结构如何？女性成员在领导职位中的参与程度如何？哪些因素影响女性参与农业合作社的领导和管理？
AI.motivation: 女性在所有经济、社会和政治领域的参与对国家发展至关重要。在埃塞俄比亚等大多数发展中国家，女性在各种管理活动中的参与度较低，特别是在领导和决策方面。农业合作社作为重要的经济组织，了解女性参与情况对促进性别平等和合作社发展具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于性别平等理论、合作社治理理论和参与式发展理论，研究关注女性在农业合作社中的领导参与问题，探讨影响参与度的社会经济因素。
AI.method: 采用多阶段抽样程序选择样本女性成员，使用描述性统计和有序logit回归模型分析数据。
AI.findings: 1. 女性在领导职位中的参与率仅为11.11%，远低于理想的50%或最低30%标准；2. 40%的女性从未参与主要合作社活动；3. 年龄、经验、教育水平、家庭规模、非农收入、牲畜资产、农田资产和家庭到合作社的距离是影响女性参与管理和领导的决定性因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了发展中国家农业合作社中女性领导参与的系统性实证证据；2. 识别了影响女性参与的多维度因素框架；3. 丰富了性别平等在合作社治理领域的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供改善女性参与合作社领导的依据；2. 为合作社管理者设计包容性治理结构提供指导；3. 为促进农村女性赋权和性别平等提供具体建议。

title: Lipschitz-Regularized Path-Strength Refactoring for Differentiable Architecture Search
affiliations: Jinan University, Jinan University, Jinan University and Jinan University

detail.title: Lipschitz-Regularized Path-Strength Refactoring for Differentiable Architecture Search
detail.abstract: Differentiable Architecture Search (DARTS) has significantly advanced neural architecture search through efficient gradient-based optimization, yet it remains hindered by optimization instability and the notorious “performance collapse” issue. In this paper, we propose Lip-DARTS, a novel framework that addresses these challenges via Lipschitz-regularized search space reformulation and path-strength refactoring. By imposing strict Lipschitz constraints, we stabilize the gradient landscape and establish a rigorous connection between loss functions and path gradients. This theoretical foundation enables the decoupling of the traditionally unstable bi-level optimization into a sequential single-level process. Specifically, architecture selection is refactored into the evaluation of path-strength metrics, allowing the search to be efficiently conducted via heuristic optimization algorithms such as Simulated Annealing (SA). Experimental results and ablation studies demonstrate that Lip-DARTS not only maintains high efficiency but also effectively circumvents performance collapse, particularly the over-representation of skip connections. Specifically, it achieves a test error of 3.11% on CIFAR-10 and an error rate of 18.74% on CIFAR-100. Notably, the method reduces the marginal search cost to merely 0.04 GPU days, offering a stable and practitioner-friendly solution for discovering high-performance architectures across diverse datasets.

AI.tldr: Lip-DARTS提出了一种基于Lipschitz正则化的可微分架构搜索框架，通过Lipschitz约束稳定梯度景观，将双层优化解耦为单层序列过程，使用路径强度度量和启发式优化算法有效避免性能崩溃问题。
AI.research_question: 如何解决DARTS中的优化不稳定性和性能崩溃问题，特别是跳跃连接过度表示的问题？
AI.motivation: DARTS虽然通过基于梯度的优化显著推进了神经架构搜索，但仍受限于优化不稳定性和"性能崩溃"问题，需要更稳定、高效的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Lipschitz正则化的搜索空间重构和路径强度重构理论，通过施加严格的Lipschitz约束来稳定梯度景观，建立损失函数与路径梯度之间的严格联系。
AI.method: Lip-DARTS框架：1）Lipschitz正则化搜索空间重构；2）路径强度度量的架构选择重构；3）使用模拟退火等启发式优化算法进行高效搜索；4）将传统不稳定的双层优化解耦为序列单层过程。
AI.findings: Lip-DARTS在CIFAR-10上达到3.11%的测试错误率，在CIFAR-100上达到18.74%的错误率，边际搜索成本仅为0.04 GPU天，有效避免了性能崩溃和跳跃连接过度表示问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了Lipschitz约束下损失函数与路径梯度的严格理论联系；2）提出了将双层优化解耦为单层序列过程的理论框架；3）发展了基于路径强度度量的架构选择理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了稳定、高效的架构搜索解决方案；2）显著降低搜索成本（0.04 GPU天）；3）有效避免性能崩溃问题；4）为跨数据集的高性能架构发现提供了实用工具。

title: The future generation of lightweight materials? A Life Cycle Assessment of fiber-reinforced composite cross car beams
affiliations: RWTH Aachen University, RWTH Aachen University, RWTH Aachen University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Dresden University of Technology, Dresden University of Technology, Dresden University of Technology and Dresden University of Technology

detail.title: The future generation of lightweight materials? A Life Cycle Assessment of fiber-reinforced composite cross car beams
detail.abstract: Fiber-reinforced composites offer promising lightweight alternatives for automotive applications, yet comprehensive life cycle assessments (LCAs) comparing them with conventional metal components remain limited. This study presents the first cradle-to-grave LCA evaluating a recyclable multi-material glass-fiber-reinforced polymer (GFRP) composite cross car beam (CCB) against an aluminium reference, considering 11 CML midpoint impact categories under different scenarios. The study has been conducted as part of a larger research project aimed at supporting the development of a more sustainable GFRP composite CCB. The composite redesign achieves lower cradle-to-grave impacts across 10 of 11 categories, with reductions of 35–37% in toxicity-related impact categories and 8–16% in Global Warming Potential. Ozone Depletion Potential represents the only trade-off (~12–13% increase), attributable to proxy-based inventory data. Despite replacing ~40% of the aluminium mass, residual aluminium supply for the hybrid composite structure dominates upstream impacts, while end-of-life (EoL) recycling credits prove decisive for resource depletion categories. These results indicate that environmental performance in hybrid multi-material composite architectures is governed by metal substitution, scrap minimization, and EoL recycling quality - conditions increasingly decisive as powertrains electrify and electricity grids decarbonize.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过生命周期评估比较了可回收玻璃纤维增强聚合物复合材料汽车横梁与铝制参考件的环境影响，发现复合材料在11个评估类别中的10个表现更优，尤其在毒性相关影响方面降低35-37%，全球变暖潜力降低8-16%。
AI.research_question: 可回收多材料玻璃纤维增强聚合物复合材料汽车横梁与铝制参考件相比，在全生命周期环境影响方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 纤维增强复合材料作为汽车轻量化替代材料具有潜力，但缺乏与常规金属部件的全面生命周期评估比较。本研究旨在支持开发更可持续的GFRP复合材料横梁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期评估理论，CML中点影响类别评估框架，多材料复合材料环境性能分析框架。
AI.method: 采用从摇篮到坟墓的生命周期评估方法，比较可回收多材料GFRP复合材料横梁与铝制参考件，考虑11个CML中点影响类别和不同情景。
AI.findings: 复合材料在11个影响类别中的10个表现更优：毒性相关影响降低35-37%，全球变暖潜力降低8-16%；仅臭氧消耗潜力增加12-13%；残余铝供应主导上游影响，报废回收对资源消耗类别至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了混合多材料复合材料环境性能的关键决定因素：金属替代、废料最小化和报废回收质量；为电动化和电网脱碳背景下的材料选择提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为汽车制造商提供复合材料替代金属部件的环境效益证据；指导可持续复合材料设计，重点关注金属替代比例、废料管理和回收系统优化。

title: Percepta: A perception-driven world-model for agent-based simulation and social system modeling
affiliations: Guangzhou City University of Technology

detail.title: Percepta: A perception-driven world-model for agent-based simulation and social system modeling
detail.abstract: Percepta is a perception-driven world-model simulation framework for agent-based modeling of social and economic systems under evolving macro conditions and institutional rules. The software formalizes perception as an explicit computational layer and adopts a world-first architecture in which global state representation and state transitions are modeled independently of agent heuristics. This design enables controlled experimentation on how heterogeneous agents form subjective interpretations and how collective outcomes emerge from their interaction with a dynamically evolving environment.
